mapper.sql: id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, aggregate_version, payload, status, owner_token, lease_until, next_attempt_at, attempts, created_at, sent_at, last_error
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO search_delivery(event_id, index_name, status, updated_at) SELECT #{eventId}, index_name, 'PENDING', #{now} FROM search_generation WHERE state IN ('ACTIVE', 'BUILDING')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox_event WHERE (status = 'NEW' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'CLAIMED' AND lease_until < #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET status = 'CLAIMED', owner_token = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox_event WHERE owner_token = #{owner} AND status = 'CLAIMED' ORDER BY id
